root_observations.observation: Single host Start admitted; B picker ORBITAL GREENHOUSE and A HOST PREPARING.
Host Play admitted and paired countdown/play view captured.
Countdown had cleared on both views.
After B right450ms/A left450ms, root observed P1 at(3,1), P2 at(13,11).
After host left+A400ms then down400ms, host P1 was OUT. Escape attempt FAILED.
After guest right+A400ms then up400ms, both human players were OUT; CPUs continued. Escape attempt FAILED.
End of marked interval showed automatic round2, both humans alive again, timer1:55. No active-play cadence claim.
Guest A Back returned Home; B showed LINK ENDED at round2 timer1:31.
Host B Back returned Home; both Home.

observation_basis: Visual findings were supplied by the root operator who inspected paired screenshots. Offline independent review verified saved P4T1 RGB565 payload hashes; these are not PNG-file hashes. No live captures were read for this record.

guarded_command_evidence.note: Journal successful guarded batch proves commands completed, not bomb escape. Host elapsed 1857.249 ms, guest 1906.795 ms, both less than 2500 ms and no screenshot inside the batches. Latency-only explanation is not established.

source_facts: Simulation tick is50ms; nominal bomb fuse is50ticks (2.5s), range initially2. Bomb placement happens before movement in the same tick.
Normal movement advances one walkable tile per3ticks (150ms); holding A does not repeatedly place bombs. Input ACK does not confirm a tile position.

From the reported host(3,1)/guest(13,11), intended safe routes turn at the outer corners(1,1)/(15,11). Turning early at x2/x14 hits the even/even pillar at y2/y10. This is a possible failed-route explanation, not an observed cause.
Full guarded host/guest batches took1.857249s/1.906795s, less than the nominal fuse, and contained no screenshot. Capture latency alone is not established as the cause.
Existing fire and CPU bombs may also kill a player; the snapshots do not identify the lethal event or intermediate path.
not_claimed: Game code regression proven by this smoke

audio_assessment: Recorded losses are real: A1296/B1408 underrun frames. Every positive adjacent loss interval overlaps a whole screenshot command, but this establishes correlation only; neither exact loss time nor cause is resolved. First counters were already nonzero. Counters and successful audio shutdown do not prove music/SFX were heard.
save_scope: SAVE_WORKER_STOP requests=0, snapshot_bytes=0, sequence=0 on both. This run did not exercise persistent save/update/relaunch. Earlier Wacky save panics remain separate unresolved OS0.73 failures.
departure_contract: Observed guest Back led to A Home/B LINK ENDED; host Back then returned B Home. Source explicitly allows A/Start from LINK ENDED to create a new solo battle, but that fallback was not exercised in this0.73 run.
counter_scope: Stop frame deadlines/max-late values are lifetime counters including setup, snapshots, spectator and transition periods. No division of whole-launch frames by elapsed time is used to qualify active play. All complete snapshot commands exclude both units for eligible cadence.
history_scope: Blast is parser launch epoch6 on each unit, not a hardware boot count. Earlier Air parse anomaly and Wacky panic/reset evidence are retained in the bound review, not attributed to Blast.
